# Explicit static ALSA SDK import; no downloading or system shared-library fallback.
set(FVM_ALSA_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Static ALSA SDK prefix with include/alsa/asoundlib.h and lib/libasound.a")
set(FVM_ALSA_AUDIO_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES "" CACHE STRING "Additional target libraries required by the supplied static ALSA SDK")
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR ANDROID)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "FVM_ENABLE_LINUX_AUDIO requires a Linux target")
endif()
foreach(component "${FVM_ALSA_ROOT}/include/alsa/asoundlib.h" "${FVM_ALSA_ROOT}/lib/libasound.a")
  if(NOT EXISTS "${component}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing static ALSA audio SDK component: ${component}; see external/audio/README.md")
  endif()
endforeach()
add_library(fvm_alsa_audio STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(fvm_alsa_audio PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${FVM_ALSA_ROOT}/lib/libasound.a")
add_library(fvm_linux_audio INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(fvm_linux_audio SYSTEM INTERFACE "${FVM_ALSA_ROOT}/include")
target_link_libraries(fvm_linux_audio INTERFACE fvm_alsa_audio ${FVM_ALSA_AUDIO_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES} Threads::Threads m ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
